verified_facts.text: The resort sits on the waters of Shaviyani Atoll in the Maldives.
verified_facts.excerpt: Edging the azure waters of Shaviyani Atoll, JW Marriott Maldives Resort & Spa is a sanctuary of scenic luxury.

verified_facts.text: The resort is on a private island in Shaviyani Atoll.
verified_facts.excerpt: a tropical island paradise situated on a private island in Shaviyani Atoll

verified_facts.text: Accommodation is in overwater villas and beach villas with private pools and decks overlooking the Indian Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: stylish overwater villas and beach villas with plush bedding, private pools and decks with stunning views of the shimmering Indian Ocean

verified_facts.text: The villas' thatched roofs recall upside-down Dhoni boats, the traditional wooden fishing vessels of the Maldives, and the slanted roof tips recall white herons dipping their heads into the water.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thatched roofs on villas are reminiscent of upside-down Dhoni boats, the traditional wooden fishing vessels of Maldives, and slanted roof tips recall white herons dipping their heads into the water.

verified_facts.text: Each villa terrace has a private wooden deck, a pool and an outdoor shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: from your private villa terrace with its own spacious private wooden deck, pool and outdoor shower

verified_facts.text: The Duplex Overwater Pool Villas have a master bedroom and an upstairs lounge with views of the Laccadive Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Duplex Overwater Pool Villas feature a spacious master bedroom and an upstairs lounge with breathtaking views of the Laccadive Sea

verified_facts.text: The Duplex Overwater Pool Villa has an infinity pool and lets guests snorkel right from the villa.
verified_facts.excerpt: This exquisite retreat features a stunning infinity pool and direct access to the vibrant marine life, allowing you to snorkel right from your villa.

verified_facts.text: The Two Bedroom Duplex Beach Pool Villa has direct beach access and personal Thakuru (butler) service.
verified_facts.excerpt: With direct beach access, your personal Thakuru (butler) service

verified_facts.text: Spa by JW is an overwater spa set above the Indian Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: SPA by JW is a refined sanctuary set above the Indian Ocean

verified_facts.text: Spa by JW treatments are inspired by four benefit states: Calm, Indulge, Invigorate and Renew.

verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind side by side in our deluxe spa suite, enjoying exclusive access to the couple’s steam bath and ice room—120 minutes of shared serenity and rejuvenation.
